note: GROUNDWORK PLATFORM DEFAULT — v1 production rules (Tyler, 2026-08-22), replacing the generic placeholder set. Categories match the 9 job-cost buckets + uncategorized/manual-review Tyler specified. A tenant with different rules overrides this file entirely via /finance/config; this is the platform-wide starting point for every tenant. Patterns are JS regex source strings (case-insensitive, applied to vendor name for stage 1 and memo/description for stage 2). Confidence maps to Tyler's percent bands: high = 95%+ (auto-resolves unless forced_review_categories/stage3 catches it), medium = 80-94.99% (always review — auto_categorize_min is 'high'), low = below 80% (always review, and if the AI stage ever runs its suggestion isn't even attached below this floor — see confidence_thresholds.stage4_fallback_min). Regardless of confidence, nothing here ever posts to job_cost_ledger — classify.ts only ever writes a classification_finding, optionally paired with an action_item(verb=decide) for a human.

stage1_vendor_patterns.pattern: \b(siteone|site ?one|ewing irrigation|john deere landscapes|landscape supply|stone yard|paver supply|sod farm)\b
\b(united rentals|sunbelt( rentals)?|herc rentals?|ahern rentals?|home depot rental)\b
\b(autozone|napa|jiffy lube|midas|firestone|discount tire|o'?reilly|valvoline|les schwab|big o tires|meineke|pep boys)\b

stage2_keyword_rules.note: High confidence is fine here even though direct_labor is a forced_review_categories entry — it always requires review regardless of confidence (normal employee payroll must come from payroll/approved time entries, never auto-classified here).
Normal employee payroll must come from payroll/approved time entries, never auto-classified into a job-cost category here — flagged for review, not silently bucketed as overhead.
An equity distribution, not a business expense in any of the 9 job-cost/overhead buckets — always manual review regardless of confidence.

stage3_amount_review_rules.reason: totals of $2,500 or more always require review regardless of match confidence

confidence_thresholds.note: A stage 1/2 match at or above auto_categorize_min resolves deterministically (writes classification_finding, no human review needed — but NEVER posts to job_cost_ledger; this classifier only ever proposes) unless it also hits a forced_review_categories entry or a stage3 amount rule. Anything below that threshold, or with no match at all, becomes a review action_item(verb='decide') — the AI stage's suggestion (if enabled) is attached to that review item as a suggestion only, never auto-applied (CLAUDE.md: never auto-post on model self-reported confidence alone). stage4_fallback_min is the floor below which the AI's suggestion isn't even attached — too low-confidence to be useful context for the reviewer.
